assertions.summary: BYOK reply rendered in Chinese and enumerated installed skills (for example lark-doc/lark-sheets/docx/pptx); console showed listSkills merging 101 skills and no filesystem-search tool-call evidence.

commands.observation: Opened a fresh BYOK compose surface using the existing Electron window.

commands.command: agent-browser --session 6ad73df32ce8__u1 fill <message-box> "你有什么技能" && click <send>
commands.observation: Created conversation f9ed3950 and triggered the BYOK skill-enumeration reply.

commands.command: agent-browser screenshot/eval/console/errors export + python3 ~/.factory/skills directory snapshot
commands.observation: Final reply rendered after an additional wait; body text contained real installed skill names (for example lark-doc, lark-sheets, docx, pptx) and console contained no read_file/glob/list_directory/grep/run_shell_command tool-call lines.

details.notes: The first in-progress screenshot briefly showed raw json-renderer content while the response was still streaming, but the final settled reply rendered correctly.

assertions.summary: Adding and then moving a temporary probe skill triggered renderer-observed slash_commands_updated events with source=skills-watcher in 719ms and 618ms respectively; Electron PID stayed unchanged.

commands.command: node (CDP validation script) -> import renderer ipcBridge and subscribe to acpConversation.responseStream slash_commands_updated events
commands.observation: Installed a renderer-side tap on conversation f9ed3950 and captured an empty baseline before the probe change.
Add-side evidence captured a droid-sdk event followed by skills-watcher in 719ms; console logged “Skills directory changed; refreshing SDK skills and slash-command menu”.
Remove-side evidence captured a second skills-watcher event in 618ms; Electron PID remained 92076 before and after the scenario.

details.notes: This renderer stream is the UI consumer of the same slash_commands_updated payloads. Ad-hoc direct window.electronAPI.on listeners injected via CDP eval were unreliable in this automation context, so the validation tap was attached one layer downstream in the renderer message pipeline.

assertions.summary: The BYOK reply rendered and enumerated many skills, but fresh-conversation boot did not expose any observable slash_commands_updated event within the monitored window, so the cross-area contract was not fully met.

commands.command: agent-browser --session 6ad73df32ce8__u1 open "http://localhost:5173/#/guid" && fill/click send for "你有什么技能"
commands.observation: Created fresh conversation 5ade2720 and produced a final Chinese skill summary that included real installed capabilities such as docx/xlsx/pptx and multiple lark-* skills.

commands.command: node (15s CDP background monitor) -> subscribe to renderer acpConversation.responseStream before sending from /guid
commands.observation: A second fresh conversation ef20ac35 reached /conversation/ef20ac35 and entered processing, but the renderer IPC monitor still recorded zero slash_commands_updated events during the boot window.

commands.command: agent-browser screenshot/eval/console export after reply completion
commands.observation: Console again showed listSkills merging 101 skills and no filesystem-search tool-call lines, but both ipc-events.json and ipc-monitor.json remained empty, so the required boot-path IPC emission could not be confirmed.

details.validatorNotes: VAL-CROSS-001/errors.log contains callback-is-not-a-function noise from an exploratory two-argument window.electronAPI.on listener attempt while debugging the runbook tap signature; that file was not used to determine the product verdict.

frictions: Ad-hoc window.electronAPI.on listener injection from CDP eval was unreliable in this runtime. To capture renderer IPC for VAL-SKILLS-013 I subscribed to the renderer's acpConversation.responseStream consumer, which receives the same slash_commands_updated payloads that the UI uses.

agent-browser intermittently returned snapshot/daemon errors such as “Invalid response: unexpected end of hex escape” and “Resource temporarily unavailable”; I worked around that by using shorter commands, extra waits, and direct CDP one-off scripts for IPC capture.
